mapper.select: SELECT * from book_subject_period_temporary where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period = #{period} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_subject_period_temporary (subject_id,period_balance,year_period,create_time,update_time) SELECT subject_id,balance,#{period},NOW(),NOW() FROM book_subject bs WHERE bs.book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.update: update book_subject_period_temporary bspt left join book_subject bs on bs.subject_id = bspt.subject_id set del_flag = '2' where bspt.year_period = #{period} and bs.book_id = #{bookId}
UPDATE book_subject_period_temporary SET period_balance = period_balance + #{diffMoney} where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period > #{yearPeriod}
